properties.note: Lowest-energy HNCO...H2O pre-reaction complex (bifurcated N-H...O(water) contact), clean minimum (15 real frequencies). Four complex conformers were optimized (runs/rc_c0..c3.log); this is the lowest. The conformer actually reached by the TS1 IRC is a higher-lying complex conformer of the same species (E=-244.926200325 Ha, ts/ts_0001/jobs/declaration_0003/reactant_frequency/).

One imaginary mode -1579.2 cm^-1: water O attacks C2 while a water H transfers to N1 and C=N becomes C-N. Formally verified by ts_prepare run ts_0001 (IRC both directions, outer frames optimized to zero-imaginary minima with identities N=C=O.O and NC(=O)O).
Carbamic acid, lowest verified minimum (anti O-H, 15 real frequencies). The same minimum was re-reached as the IRC product endpoint (E=-244.96649606 Ha).

One imaginary mode -1656.7 cm^-1: the hydroxyl H moves to N1 while C2-N1 breaks and C2-O4 becomes the second C=O of CO2. Formally verified by ts_prepare run ts_0002 (IRC to separated N + O=C=O with component minimum evidence).

NH3 + CO2 product complex. This loose complex is not a clean minimum at this level (two very small imaginary modes, -28.6 and -16.4 cm^-1, near-free relative motion); per-component evidence: runs/nh3_opt.log (smiles: N, E=-56.5106949583 Ha) and runs/co2_opt.log (smiles: O=C=O, E=-188.444679570 Ha), component sum -244.9553745283 Ha.
Gauche O-H rotamer of carbamic acid; degenerate mirror pair, runs/im1_g1_opt.log and runs/im1_g2_opt.log give the same energy. 8.3 kcal/mol above IM1.
One imaginary mode -272.4 cm^-1 = O-H torsion; conformational transition state between IM1 and IM1_rot (C-O and N-C framework essentially unchanged).

edges.channel: water addition across the C=N bond (carbamic-acid formation)
